EXECUTE [EDS].[SP_EDS_CUSTOMER_DIM] '2023-09-05'
 YE
SELECT TOP 100 ORGKEY, BANK_ID FROM EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM --where ATM_ENROLLMENT='Y' OR MOBILE_BANKING_ENROLLMENT='Y' OR ONLINE_BANKING_ENROLLMENT='Y'
SELECT TOP 100 ORGKEY, BANK_ID,MOBILE_BANKING_ENROLLMENT FROM EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM WHERE ORGKEY='R01992755'

SELECT
(CASE WHEN MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB.CIF_NO IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END) AS MOBILE_BANKING_ENROLLMENT, MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB.SCD_Start_Date , MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB.SCD_End_Date
,MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB.CIF_NO
FROM d360.STG_EDS_CRM_ACCOUNTS CUST
LEFT JOIN EDS.MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB AS MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB
ON CUST.ORGKEY = MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB.CIF_NO
AND CUST.BANK_ID = MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB.BNK_CODE
--AND CAST('20231010' AS DATE) BETWEEN MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB.SCD_Start_Date AND MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB.SCD_End_Date
WHERE  ORGKEY='R01992755'


SELECT * FROM EDS.ATM_CLIENT WHERE CLT_CIF_NUMBER='R00260450'

SELECT * FROM EDS.MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB WHERE CIF_NO='R01992755'


TRUNCATE TABLE EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM

SELECT * FROM OM.OM_TASK_RUN WHERE TASK_NAME LIKE '%CUSTOMER_DIM%' OR TASK_NAME LIKE '%TSK_STG_EDS_CRM_ACCOUNTS%'


INSERT INTO [OM].[OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY]
(DEPENDENCY_ID, TASK_NAME,DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME)
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL))+ (SELECT ISNULL(MAX(DEPENDENCY_ID),0) FROM [OM].[OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY]) , 'TSK_EDS_BOB_TBLACCOUNT' TASK_NAME,'TSK_EDS_CUSTOMER_DIM' DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME
